# The stamp is about the answer and not about where it came from. A process
# running for days asks for it rather than rebuilding everything, so a stamp
# that moved when only the rung moved would rebuild for nothing.
stamp
# expect 1: ok first
user {"store":"A"}
# expect 2: ok
stamp
# expect 3: ok differs [CFG-W2]
stamp
# expect 4: ok same [CFG-W2]
env store A
# expect 5: ok
stamp
# expect 6: ok same [CFG-W2]
env store B
# expect 7: ok
stamp
# expect 8: ok differs [CFG-W2]
